title: Verification and CI feedback
description: Prove a change works before calling it done, and react to CI the right way.

rules.title: Narrowest check first
rules.text: Run the narrowest relevant test first, then widen to the package and workspace checks as confidence grows.

rules.title: Format and lint before commit
rules.text: Run the project formatter and linter on changed files before committing, using the repo scripts or hooks.

rules.title: Reproduce, then fix
rules.text: For a bug fix, reproduce the failure first, then show the regression test failing without the fix and passing with it.

rules.title: No unproven "done"
rules.text: Report a task as done only after running the checks that prove it. If you could not run them, say so.

rules.title: Final self-review
rules.text: Before finishing, re-read the full diff as a reviewer with no knowledge of this session and fix what would confuse them.

rules.title: Not "pre-existing" by default
rules.text: Do not assume a failing check or a warning was already there. Prove it on a clean base before calling it pre-existing.

rules.title: One-shot test runs
rules.text: Run tests once in CI mode. Never leave a watch process or dev server running in the foreground of an agent session.

rules.title: Generous timeouts
rules.text: Give slow installs, builds and integration suites long timeouts and do not cancel them early.

rules.title: Reproduce CI locally
rules.text: Reproduce a CI failure locally with the seed, flags and environment printed in the log before changing code.

rules.title: Read the failed job
rules.text: Read only the failed job log and its annotations instead of paging through the whole run.

rules.title: Review snapshots
rules.text: Read changed snapshots as behavior changes. Never accept them blindly.

rules.title: No leftover focus
rules.text: Check for leftover focused tests such as .only, fit or fdescribe before finishing.

rules.title: Cross-platform paths
rules.text: Normalize path separators in tests so they pass on Windows as well as Linux and macOS.

rules.title: Generated files check
rules.text: After touching sources of generated code, run the repo check that confirms generated files are up to date.

rules.title: Fresh-context reviewer
rules.text: When a subagent is available, have it review the finished change from the scope and requirements only, without your suspected defects.

rules.title: Ratchet legacy debt
rules.text: Where legacy warnings exist, use a ratchet so the warning count may fall but never rise.
